description: Single-device offline complete-state projection known answers (SPEC-v2 §7.13). Every SDK that implements the profile loads each state into its primary and MUST reproduce every canonical member byte string, member digest, projection object, and complete-state digest exactly.
label: ratify/device-complete-state/v2

semantics.\u003cmember\u003e_canonical_json: the exact RatifyCanonicalJSON of that projection member: each record array sorted by its §7.13 primary key, terminal_b64, receipt_body_b64, and body_b64 replaced by the lowercase hex SHA-384 of their bytes, receipt_log carrying log_id and 1-based sequence
semantics.\u003cmember\u003e_sha384: lowercase hex SHA-384 of the member's canonical bytes
semantics.projection_canonical_json: the exact RatifyCanonicalJSON of the version 1 projection object
semantics.state: the primary's durable records in the record encodings of SPEC-v2 §7.13, listed out of order; claims carry the exact sealed terminal-result and receipt-outbox bytes as terminal_b64 and receipt_body_b64 (null when absent), receipt_log entries carry body_b64 in sequence order, and security_journal carries the exact canonical snapshot bytes as snapshot_b64. Byte strings are opaque here: they are hashed, never parsed

cases.name: empty_primary
cases.description: a freshly provisioned primary: no records, every collection an empty array, the genesis SecurityJournalV2 snapshot, replay epoch 0

cases.name: evaluating_claim
cases.description: one stream-bound claim just created: evaluating, initial progress, no terminal result, receipt body, log position, or release record (all null); its stream advance and its issuance record with no expected agent, receiver, context, or policy

cases.name: every_record_kind
cases.description: every record kind, listed out of order: a released allow with a rate batch, evaluator snapshot, two issuer IDs, and an appended receipt; a committed deny whose receipt is not yet appended (entry_hash null); a claim interrupted after lease expiry with recorded progress; streams whose namespaces order differently in UTF-8 and UTF-16; issuance records with a bound and an unbound context policy, a full expected agent key, and a namespace containing U+2028; rate counters ordered by issuer, certificate, and window

cases.name: every_record_kind_without_release
cases.description: every_record_kind with the release record of claim-a absent: only the claims member and the complete-state digest change

cases.name: every_record_kind_with_withheld_record
cases.description: every_record_kind with claim-a's record a recorded withheld result (outcome withheld, reason allow_horizon_passed, SPEC-v2 §6.9) instead of a release: only the claims member and the complete-state digest change

cases.name: abandoned_frozen_log
cases.description: a terminal claim whose receipt was abandoned before it was appended, in a frozen receipt log, at the maximum safe replay epoch and journal generation
